violation_type.title: Exceeding Maximum Group Size - 3 and 4 Years (30 mins) (26 TAC §744.1609(a)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Exceeding Maximum Group Size - 3 and 4 Years (30 mins)
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation was observed to have 48 children ages 4-10 years old in one group for over 30 minutes exceeding the maximum group size allowed.  The children were seperated into two groups during the inspection.
